definitions.explanation: Describes something that has just been ground, most commonly coffee beans, pepper, or flour.

examples.japanese: {挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
{挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I sprinkled freshly ground pepper on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{淹|い}れている→淹れる：13297_ireru⟧。
examples.english: This café brews coffee every morning using freshly ground beans.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{挽|ひ}く→挽く：12794_hiku⟧ (to grind) and たて (just done, freshly). The たて suffix indicates something has just been completed and is at its freshest. Almost always used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜. Most commonly associated with coffee, but also used for pepper, spices, and flour.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧: freshly ground coffee
- {挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧: freshly ground beans
- {挽|ひ}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧: freshly ground pepper

SIMILAR PATTERNS (〜たて):
- ⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧: freshly baked
- {炊|た}きたて: freshly cooked (rice)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げたて→揚げたて：16736_agetate⟧: freshly fried
- ⟦{作|つく}りたて→作りたて：20011_tsukuritate⟧: freshly made
